name: Journal
line: A slow nature magazine on warm paper: the cover is a golden misty bog with the headline set as the cover line in the fog, and each later section is a half-bleed spread (wild barley, the two explorers drawn in sage, a leaf shadow) whose picture opens from the spine like a turning page, with a full-bleed moonlit fjord as the one photographic pause.
notes: The kit's data-reveal="wipe" (and "mask") never fire in Chromium because the clipped element is invisible to IntersectionObserver, so the page-turn uses a custom value (data-reveal="page") on the figure and clips the inner page, opening from the spine side. Below 900px the cover line moves under the photograph. Captions carry photo credits as in a magazine, and the footer lists them again. Brygada 1918 has Cyrillic; Albert Sans does not, so captions and nav on the RU site would need a fallback.
